title: Limit on the Rural Home Loans Returned-Payment Fee by Size of the Returned Remittance
content:
On Rural Home Loans, the returned-payment fee is limited by the size of the returned remittance.

## Clause

The fee is limited by the size of the returned remittance, which is the interest, principal and escrow shares that the return reversed: a returned remittance of at least 1000.00 USD and below 2500.00 USD limits the fee to 2.5 percent of that remittance, rounded to the cent; a returned remittance below 1000.00 USD limits it to 1.5 percent of that remittance, rounded to the cent; a larger remittance places no limit on the fee. The fee is the lower of the fee and its limit.

## Size of the returned remittance

The amounts on the remittance's return entries — the interest payment return, the principal payment return and the escrow deposit return — added together and rounded to the cent; a share with no return entry adds nothing.

## Bands

| Size of the returned remittance | Limit |
|---|---|
| below 1000.00 | 1.5 percent of the remittance, rounded to the cent |
| 1000.00 up to but not including 2500.00 | 2.5 percent of the remittance, rounded to the cent |
| 2500.00 or more | no limit |

## Boundary cases (hypothetical remittances)

| Remittance | Limit |
|---|---|
| 999.99 | 1.5 percent: 14.99985, rounded to 15.00 |
| 1000.00 | 2.5 percent: 25.00 |
| 2499.99 | 2.5 percent: 62.49975, rounded to 62.50 |
| 2500.00 | no limit |

## Worked case (hypothetical inputs)

A returned remittance of 1200.00 (interest 650.00, principal 250.00, escrow 300.00) limits the fee to 2.5 percent of 1200.00, that is 30.00. A fee of 40.00 is held to 30.00; a fee of 25.00 is below the limit and stays 25.00.
